name: intsum
algorithm: Sum of n int64 values in 0..1023 from splitmix64 (Fill, untimed), passes times, each pass writing its sum & 1023 back into element r % n (Run, timed); the algorithm of ../../same/intsum.
measures: Mk's checked + and bounds checks against C's add nsw (budget: overflow checks at most 5 percent, design/budgets.md)
